intro.uz: Jahongir blogida Chorvoqdagi dam olish haqida yozadi. Oʻqishdan oldin: siz dam olish kunlari qayerga borishni yoqtirasiz?

paragraphs.en: Hi, everyone! This weekend my family and I are at Charvak. It is a big lake in the mountains near Tashkent. The water is blue and very clean.
paragraphs.uz: Hammaga salom! Bu dam olish kunlari men oilam bilan Chorvoqdaman. Bu — Toshkent yaqinidagi togʻlarda joylashgan katta koʻl. Suvi moviy va juda toza.

paragraphs.en: Today the weather is sunny and hot. My little brother is swimming now, and my father is sitting in the shade. My mother is making tea.
paragraphs.uz: Bugun havo quyoshli va issiq. Ukam hozir suzyapti, otam esa soyada oʻtiribdi. Onam choy damlayapti.

paragraphs.en: There are a lot of hotels and small cafés here. In summer, many people come from Tashkent. You can swim, ride a boat or walk in the mountains.
paragraphs.uz: Bu yerda koʻplab mehmonxonalar va kichik kafelar bor. Yozda Toshkentdan koʻp odamlar keladi. Bu yerda suzish, qayiqda sayr qilish yoki togʻlarda piyoda sayr qilish mumkin.

paragraphs.en: In the evening it is cool, so I wear a jacket. I love Charvak! I would like to come here again next summer.
paragraphs.uz: Kechqurun salqin boʻladi, shuning uchun kurtka kiyaman. Men Chorvoqni yaxshi koʻraman! Kelasi yozda bu yerga yana kelishni xohlayman.
